breaking_changes: Hapi 16 to @hapi/hapi 21 and Inert 4 to @hapi/inert 7 change package names and server/plugin/handler lifecycle APIs.
Babel 6 preset/plugin naming and configuration are incompatible with @babel/core/@babel/preset-env 7 and babel-loader 9.
Webpack 4 to 5 invalidates legacy plugins/options and webpack-dev-server 3 to 5 removes devServer keys and changes proxy schema.
http-proxy-middleware v3 proxy contexts cannot mix glob and literal string forms in one context array; legacy and USE_SPA proxy branches both require runtime verification.
node-sass is unsupported on Node 18/20; both standalone SCSS and Vue SFC SCSS paths currently route through legacy sass-loader options.
Gulp 4 removes dependency-array task composition used throughout gulpfile.js.
request callback/defaults calls are synchronously wrapped by wait.for; axios 1 uses promises and different response/error shapes.
Bootstrap 5 removes jQuery integration and is incompatible with BootstrapVue 2's Bootstrap 4 contract; the Vue 2.7 interim choice does not resolve that conflict.
Vue 2.7 requires matching vue-template-compiler and compatible vue-loader/plugin versions.
The search-results template embeds axios 0.16.1 independently of package.json, so audit remediation requires accounting for this browser copy.
Phenogrid is consumed through a generated global/jQuery bundle and is a high-risk webpack 5/Babel 7 interoperability path.
No async 2.x queue.drain property assignments were found, so the known async 3 behavioral break is not currently implicated; no uglify-js array-of-filename minify calls were found.
risk_summary.notes: GitNexus was used for execution-flow/symbol discovery and targeted rg reads supplied exact line locations. No package-lock.json or npm-shrinkwrap.json is present, so npm install will create/update lock state. The package script wbs-lint references wbs.eslintrc, but that file was not found. webpack.make.js appears secondary to webpack.config.js but is direct webpack usage and remains in scope. External live-service failures must be distinguished from local upgrade regressions.

coverage_notes: GitNexus index monarch-legacy was available (1048 symbols, 2126 relationships, 67 flows) and identified server, phenotype, and UI flows; textual searches covered direct imports, build configuration, proxy paths, and declared external services. External GOLR, SciGraph, OwlSim, and Biolink versions are not recorded in the repository and remain unknown; checked conf/server_config_dev.json, conf/server_config_beta.json, conf/server_config_production.json, ui/monarchAccess/servers.js, lib/monarch/api.js, and webpack.config.js. These services require live verification, but their unreachability is an external dependency issue per user direction. Analysis was read-only for the target repository.
